name: CCR-Bench
description: CCR-Bench is a benchmark designed to assess large language models' adherence to complex instructions involving deep entanglement of content and formatting, intricate task decomposition, conditional reasoning, and procedural planning, with evaluation samples derived from real-world industrial scenarios.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from 2026 that is not yet widely established, but it is positioned as a specialized test of instruction-following and formatting fidelity in realistic industrial settings.
notes: Focuses on complex constraints, control flows, and real-world cases; highlights gap between current LLM capabilities and industrial instruction understanding.
